task_completion.description: Log in to the Odoo system with admin credentials.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The VLM should see the Odoo dashboard or calendar view after the login screen, with 'admin' visible as the user profile.

task_completion.description: Locate and open the 'Team Standup' meeting on next Monday.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A calendar view showing the 'Team Standup' event on the correct date, and the event details window or edit form being opened.

task_completion.description: Enable the 'Recurrent' checkbox in the event settings.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Recurrent' checkbox is checked, revealing the recurrence options (Repeat Every, Weeks, etc.).

task_completion.description: Set the recurrence to Weekly on Mondays and Thursdays.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The recurrence type is set to 'Weeks', and both 'Mon' and 'Thu' (or Monday and Thursday) buttons/checkboxes are selected in the recurrence configuration.

task_completion.description: Set the recurrence to end after exactly 10 occurrences.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'End' or 'Stop' condition is set to 'Number of repetitions' or 'After', and the value '10' is entered in the count field.
The agent clicks the 'Save' button, and the calendar view updates to show the recurring instances of the meeting.

integrity.description: The agent used the Odoo web interface rather than executing database commands via terminal.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show mouse movements, clicks on UI elements, and form filling within the browser.

integrity.description: The agent navigated through the application rather than jumping directly to a final state URL if not provided.
integrity.visual_evidence: The trajectory shows the process of opening the calendar and clicking the specific event.

integrity.description: The agent interacted with the actual Odoo instance and did not simulate the result using image editing or mockups.
integrity.visual_evidence: Consistent UI rendering, loading states, and standard Odoo interface behavior across the screenshot sequence.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The target event is named 'Team Standup'. It is initially scheduled for next Monday. The recurrence must be configured as: Repeat: Weekly; Days: Monday (mon) and Thursday (thu); End Type: Count (Number of repetitions); Count: 10. Ensure the agent selects both Monday and Thursday, as Odoo often defaults to only the current day.
